name: neuropulse-focus
description: NeuroPulse — 轻量级反应力与专注力训练跨端应用 (macOS / Windows 11 / Android / iOS)
author: NeuroPulse Studio

scripts.build: pnpm run build:frontend && pnpm run build:electron
scripts.pack:mac: pnpm run build && pnpm run build:backend && electron-builder --mac --dir --publish never
scripts.dist:mac: pnpm run build && pnpm run build:backend && electron-builder --mac --publish never
scripts.dist:win: pnpm run build && pnpm run build:backend && electron-builder --win --publish never
scripts.mobile:sync: pnpm run build:frontend && pnpm --dir frontend exec cap sync
scripts.mobile:android: pnpm run build:frontend && pnpm --dir frontend exec cap sync android && pnpm --dir frontend exec cap open android
scripts.mobile:ios: pnpm run build:frontend && pnpm --dir frontend exec cap sync ios && pnpm --dir frontend exec cap open ios
